repair and servicing of industrial machinery and mechanical equipment to ensure 
safe and efficient operations.

requirements

reliability

equivalent recognised trade qualification

maintenance or engineering environments

• Ability to interpret engineering drawings and technical manuals 
• Strong problem-solving ability 
• Excellent communication and teamwork skills 
• Commitment to workplace health and safety

- Heavy wall pipe fabrication 
- Plate fabrication 
- Structural steel fabrication 
- Preparation, cutting, welding, grinding, drilling

- Cert III in Engineering Fabrication or equivalent 
- At least 3 years’ experience as a welder or related trade 
- Ability to read and interpret drawings to a high standard 
- Safety first attitude 
- Carbon and stainless-steel experience essential 
- Proficiency in MIG, TIC and Arc welding 
    

Salary range is $75,000-$105,000 dependent on qualifications and experience

Multiple Full-time Positions available

Applications open on 24th July 2026 and closes on 24th August 2026

If you are interested in this role APPLY now. Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted.
